name: LY Corporation
summary: LY Corporation engages in the online advertising and e-commerce businesses in Japan. It operates through three segments: Media Business, Commerce Business, and Strategic Business. The Media Business segment offers advertising solutions, including search ads, account advertising, display advertising, and various digital content and membership services such as LINE Official Accounts, LINE promotional stamps, LINE flyers, LINE News, LINE Music, LYP Premium, and Yahoo! Email. The Commerce Business segment provides e-commerce services and platforms, including Yahoo! Shopping, ZOZOTOWN, ZOZOUSED, Lyst, ASKUL BtoB office-related product sales, LOHACO, Yahoo! Auctions, Yahoo! Flea Market, Ikyu.com, …
